title: [tenmin-range-reply-dust] tenMinMassiveRequestsOf: characterization test for valid, invalid and missing request counts
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for tenMinMassiveRequestsOf in src/tenmin-range-reply-dust.ts: request counts
- tenMinMassiveRequestsOf({ tenMinMassiveRequests: 3 }) is 3
- tenMinMassiveRequestsOf({ tenMinMassiveRequests: 0 }) is 0
- tenMinMassiveRequestsOf({ tenMinMassiveRequests: -2 }) is 0
- tenMinMassiveRequestsOf({ tenMinMassiveRequests: 1.5 }) is 0
- tenMinMassiveRequestsOf({ tenMinMassiveRequests: "4" }) is 0
- tenMinMassiveRequestsOf(null) is 0
- tenMinMassiveRequestsOf("boom") is 0

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v6): Peace's task (source: peace). tenMinMassiveRequestsOf has no test; a positive count, and zero for 0, negative, fractional, string, null and non-object values are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 0ab37c8 (Workspace main 1e8448a, live 30-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v6); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with tenMinMassiveRequestsOf stubbed); suite 613/613 with all fifteen new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
